episodes.synopsis: In Broccoli Village, Welsh lives a peaceful life baking pies with Mama Caroni. However, that peaceful daily life comes to an abrupt end following a certain incident.
episodes.title: Mushroom Pie

episodes.synopsis: Welsh and his companions barely escaped with their lives after their village was attacked. As they searched for help to save the wounded Welsh, a new encounter awaited them.
episodes.title: Cheese Omelet

episodes.synopsis: The pursuers targeting Welsh and his companions begin to make their move. Meanwhile, through an old folktale being told, the group comes to realize the sheer scale of the world surrounding them.
episodes.title: Licorice Tea

episodes.synopsis: With pursuers closing in, Welsh and his companions continue their journey in search of treatment. However, a new danger awaits them. Cornered, the group flees to a certain place.
episodes.title: Caramelized Skewers

episodes.synopsis: Through a mysterious experience, Welsh and Shedar come face to face with a certain being. With the mission entrusted to them in their hearts, the group embarks on a new journey.
episodes.title: Beef Stewed in Beer

episodes.synopsis: The group continues their journey towards their destination. However, along the way, a series of unsettling events occur.
episodes.title: Grilled Meats and Seafood

episodes.synopsis: As the ambitions of a formidable enemy unfold, the group ventures into a mysterious place. What awaits them there are memories of the past and a new anomaly.
episodes.title: Zabel's Dinner Table

episodes.synopsis: The truth that is revealed shakes Welsh and Shedder's positions to their core. They both come to understand the roles they must play.
episodes.title: Cat Bouillon

episodes.synopsis: Burdened by deep pain, the group begins to go their separate ways, each with their own resolve. The story then moves to the city that will become the heart of the narrative.
episodes.title: Apple Compote
